Ben Shelton. First Grand Slam final.

He defeated Frances Tiafoe 4-6, 6-3, 6-3, 7-5 in the all-American semifinals.

The 23-year drought is over. An American man plays in the US Open final on Sunday. #USOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Ben Shelton is the first Black American man to reach a US Open final since Arthur Ashe in 1972.

He's 23 years old. He won it in four sets last night. He plays Zverev on Sunday.

The history being made at Arthur Ashe Stadium this week. #USOpen

facebook.long_form:
**Window:** 8:00 AM ET

Ben Shelton is going to a Grand Slam final for the first time in his career.

Friday night at Arthur Ashe Stadium, the 23-year-old American defeated Frances Tiafoe 4-6, 6-3, 6-3, 7-5 in an emotionally charged all-American semifinal. Tiafoe won the opening set and looked like he might run away with it. Shelton found another gear.

He takes Sunday's final against No. 1 Alexander Zverev — the Roland Garros champion who has now reached three consecutive Grand Slam finals in 2026. It's one of the great individual matchups of the year.

The history doesn't stop there. Shelton is also the first Black American man to reach a US Open final since Arthur Ashe in 1972. He'll be walking onto a court named for the man he's now following in those footsteps.

What are you feeling going into Sunday? Who wins it?

---

stories.title: Zverev Survives Khachanov to Reach Third Consecutive Grand Slam Final of 2026 (TIER 1)

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Alexander Zverev: Roland Garros final (won). Wimbledon final. US Open final.

Three Grand Slam finals in one year. Three different surfaces.

He beat Khachanov 6-3, 7-6, 7-6 on Friday. One of the great seasons in tennis. #USOpen

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The scoreline says 6-3, 7-6, 7-6. Easy, right?

Khachanov led the third-set tiebreak 4-1 with two set points. Zverev was one break from elimination.

He slammed the door. Third Grand Slam final of 2026. #USOpen #Zverev

facebook.long_form:
**Window:** 9:30 AM ET

How dominant has Alexander Zverev been in 2026?

He won Roland Garros in June — his first Grand Slam title. He reached the Wimbledon final. And on Friday, he defeated Karen Khachanov 6-3, 7-6, 7-6 to reach the US Open final — becoming just the 12th man since 1978 to reach Grand Slam finals on three different surfaces in a single season.

It nearly didn't happen. Khachanov led the third-set tiebreak 4-1 with two set points. Zverev erased them.

Sunday he faces Ben Shelton for the title. It is his sixth career Grand Slam final and his second of 2026. One of the most remarkable individual seasons in modern tennis.

How do you see Zverev vs. Shelton playing out?

facebook.long_form:
**Window:** 1:00 PM ET

The US Open women's final is here — Aryna Sabalenka vs. Elena Rybakina, 4 PM ET today on ESPN.

The defending champion against the new world No. 1. Sabalenka is chasing her third consecutive US Open title — a feat only Serena Williams has accomplished in the Open Era (2012-2014). If she does it, she cements herself among the greatest US Open champions in history.

Rybakina, who defeated Sabalenka in January's Australian Open final, becomes the world No. 1 starting Monday regardless of today's result. Her chance to sweep 2026's two hardcourt majors — the Australian Open and the US Open — arrives this afternoon.

Head-to-head entering today: Sabalenka leads 10-7. But Rybakina won the last time they met in a Grand Slam final.

This is their third Grand Slam final. You don't want to miss it.

Who are you rooting for today?

stories.title: Zverev vs. Shelton — The Men's Final That Rewrites History (TIER 1)

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Sunday. US Open men's final.

No. 1 Alexander Zverev vs. No. 8 Ben Shelton.

Zverev wins = second Grand Slam of 2026.
Shelton wins = first American men's Grand Slam title since Andy Roddick in 2003.

The weight of that. #USOpen

facebook.long_form:
**Window:** 2:30 PM ET

Sunday at Arthur Ashe Stadium: Alexander Zverev vs. Ben Shelton. 4 PM ET on ESPN.

If Ben Shelton wins, he becomes the first American man to win a Grand Slam title since Andy Roddick lifted the trophy at the 2003 US Open — ending a 23-year drought for American men's tennis. He would be 23 years old, playing in his first Grand Slam final, on the court named after the last Black American man to make a US Open final.

If Alexander Zverev wins, he captures his second Grand Slam title of 2026, following his Roland Garros victory in June. He would become one of the few men in the Open Era to win two majors in a single calendar year.

Zverev leads their career head-to-head, but this is a different stage. This is a Grand Slam final. Shelton has already shown this tournament that form means nothing when he beat Alcaraz at 3:33 AM.

Sunday is going to be special. Who do you have?

---

stories.title: First Black American Man in US Open Final Since Arthur Ashe — The Weight of Shelton's Moment (TIER 2)

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The last Black American man to reach a US Open final was Arthur Ashe — 1972.

54 years later, Ben Shelton walks onto the court named for him on Sunday.

Some moments are bigger than tennis. #USOpen #BenShelton

facebook.long_form:
**Window:** 12:00 PM ET

Ben Shelton will play in the US Open final on Sunday at Arthur Ashe Stadium.

The last Black American man to reach a US Open final was Arthur Ashe — in 1972. The court where Shelton plays Sunday is named after him.

The last Black American man to reach any Grand Slam final was MaliVai Washington at Wimbledon in 1996 — thirty years ago.

Shelton and Frances Tiafoe both reached the semifinals of the same draw. Whatever happened on Friday night — and whoever lifts the trophy on Sunday — this US Open will be remembered.

The game has always been big enough. Sometimes the moment catches up to it.

---
